clips.send: A friend deep into manifesting content who insists knowing it is enough - a jolt of unease, since even the person who taught it best couldn't out-think his own fear.
clips.caption:
Jerry Hicks helped build the Law of Attraction teaching the whole modern manifesting world studies — the "Abraham" material, millions of copies.

He still died of cancer.

Kevin's point isn't that the teaching is false. It's that knowing something and being free of fearing it are two different things. Jerry understood manifestation better than almost anyone alive, and he spent that illness afraid of it — and what you fear, you keep feeding.

The block was never his vocabulary. It was whatever he hadn't stopped being afraid of.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to find yours.

#lawofattraction #manifestation #subconscious #fearless #awakening #kevintrudeau

clips.send: A friend who trains martial arts and insists qi energy is pseudoscience - send to make them double-take, half awe half 'wait, really?'
clips.caption:
Someone hits him as hard as they can, square in the stomach. His face doesn't even move.

It isn't a trick and it isn't numbness. A few inches below the navel is a point the old energy traditions trained for years — call it the dan tien, call it the qi ball — and when it's full, the body around it holds like stone. This isn't about being tough. It's about what becomes possible once you can hold something there on command: less stress, a calmer nervous system, a body that isn't running on cortisol all day.

The point was never the punch. It was proof the practice does something real.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how it's trained.
